title: Goose Guard
description: A side-scrolling lane battle game. Walk your goose knight down the lane, spend grain to send chicks, egg-throwing hens, rams, bees, war pigs, fire roosters and moo tanks against the Weed Horde, and HONK to blast their army back. Smash the weed tower in 60 stages across six worlds with a boss every ten, earn acorns for upgrades, and survive Endless Horde for the global leaderboard. Free, no download, works on phone.
